Questions

Do I need to know any English?

No. The Sprint is made for starting from zero. If you can say "hello", you're ahead.

How much time a day?

About twenty minutes. In one go or in short bits.

What are the calls with Mei like?

Video call, 25 minutes, at a time you book. The first is to meet and get going; the last is for your 2-minute talk.

What if I can't one day?

That's fine. The Sprint moves with you, not with the calendar: you pick up where you left off.

Can I get a refund?

In full if you cancel before your first call with Mei. After that, within 14 days, we refund the part you have not used yet. We don't refund based on the outcome: the Sprint gives you the plan and Mei, the practice is yours. It's all in the terms.
